findings.claim: Suppressing consuming-project diagnostics for members of types defined in referenced assemblies, and documenting that those diagnostics belong to the defining project, is deliberate product behavior rather than a loss of required analyzer coverage.

receipt_plan.detail: [L8] Types from referenced assemblies are deliberately not analyzed and receive no formatter or MsgPack003/004/005 diagnostic from the consuming compilation; the defining assembly owns validation. The new diagnostic filtering and documentation implement that recorded convention.
